prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Create a FINISHED display advertisement supplied by an independent advertiser, not a photograph for a web page, not a website component or card. The finished raster includes its own complete brand identity, campaign typography, artwork, persuasive copy and a prominent call-to-action drawn into the advertisement. All requested Italian wording must be exact and highly legible. Professional real-world ad agency art direction. Use only the brief's copy; no fake prices, discounts, deadlines or added claims. No weather-site branding or shared weather palette. No outer frame or watermark. Make the entire canvas the single ad; no grid of options, no mockup screen.
Format: HALF PAGE 300×600, portrait ratio 1:2. Generate a tall vertical canvas; full finished ad from top to bottom.
Input image 1: authentic UniMiB logo, preserve its exact recognizable silhouette and lettering. Input image 2: photo mood reference, use a similar credible academic group.
Creative concept: institutional university recruitment poster. A white top area with the authentic Bicocca logo, ample clear margin. Burgundy #952d40 fills the main field. Hero type is white condensed PT Sans Narrow-like sans. A horizontal white rule separates title from an academic photo showing diverse adult students collaborating on paper prototypes in a university study room. Bottom band is white with burgundy button.
Text verbatim: "Teoria e Tecnologia della comunicazione"; smaller "Laurea magistrale · Milano-Bicocca"; clear secondary line "Informatica. Psicologia. Design."; CTA "Scopri il corso". Make the title intentionally break across multiple bold lines. This is visually a university advertisement, not a weather card. No generic navy/orange colour scheme.
